Furnished 2-Bedroom Detached Laneway Home | Dunbar-Southlands | Near UBC
From $3,600/month | Unit Video Available
Brand-new, fully furnished 2-bed, 2-bath detached laneway home in quiet, highly sought-after Dunbar-Southlands. Fully independent from the main house, private entrance, no shared walls. A private home, not a converted suite.
Ideal for corporate relocations, visiting faculty and researchers, graduate students, professionals, and small families relocating to the area.
Located in the Lord Kitchener Elementary / Lord Byng Secondary catchment, one of the West Side's most requested school zones.
Approximately 732 sq ft, finished with quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, laminate flooring, and three energy-efficient mini-split heat pumps (heating + A/C year-round). Both bedrooms include a desk and ergonomic chair. Upper bedroom has a private balcony. In-suite laundry, security alarm, move-in ready.
One block to King Edward Ave, two blocks to Dunbar Street. Easy access to grocery, coffee, restaurants, and parks.
Flexible Pricing, The Longer You Stay, The More You Save
•	3-5 months: $3,800/month
•	6-11 months: $3,700/month
•	12 months: $3,600/month
Included: Wi-Fi, Smart TV, water, sewer, garbage, recycling
Tenant pays: Electricity (separate meter)
Street parking available. Non-smoking, no vaping, no pets.
Questions about the neighbourhood, schools, or which lease term fits you best? Reach out anytime, we'll help you find the right fit.
